subject.title: [Feature]: Support Anthropic native server-side tools (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution)

question: Which Anthropic server-tools scope should OpenClaw accept for this broad tracker: native web_search only, web_search plus web_fetch, or code_execution/PTC with allowed_callers as well?
rationale: Provider-hosted code execution and server-result replay affect security defaults, billing visibility, transcript/session state, and plugin API/config shape, so automation should not choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Stage Web Tools First
options.body: Implement native web_search/web_fetch and generic server-result preservation first, then split code_execution/PTC into a separate security-reviewed follow-up.

options.title: Implement Full Server Tools
options.body: Accept web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, and allowed_callers in one coordinated design with stronger security and billing review before merge.

options.title: Keep Native Search Narrow
options.body: Limit this cycle to the narrower Anthropic native web_search provider and close or defer the rest as separate product work.

recommendation.title: Stage Web Tools First
recommendation.body: Implement native web_search/web_fetch and generic server-result preservation first, then split code_execution/PTC into a separate security-reviewed follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter posted the latest keep-open review and is the strongest recent routing owner for the cross-cutting runtime/product decision.
